notes.title: New: Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning - Relaunch
notes.content: We have been working to rebuild this entirely and now have completed in UE5. We have gone through a lot of changes in the company, and this has taken much longer than we expected but we are launching the new CITB game. This is essentially an update with basically a new game completely. We are confident the game is now an exceptional experience, very engaging, with strong replay ability with its design. In our rebuild in UE5 we have also adding a considerable amount of additional content with several changes to the game play. CITB when is now what was intended, and dramatically improved, with using the benefits of UE5 and many additions to the game play. We have made tremendous changes to all the art, UI, characters and overall flow of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE: Cypress Inheritance: GTX 1080 Ti and HTC VIVE Contest!
notes.content:
We want to again say thank you to all the people who have our game, we do appreciate the support and feedback!

We started a contest early this year to help to market the game as is and let everyone know about the complete remake of the game. This is still ongoing and we do expect to have out in the last quarter of 2017. 

We are completely rebuilding in UE4 for PC and Mac. We will also  make available for the HTC VIVE and Oculus as well. Additionally we will have the game available in Simplified Chinese.

We have not had a winner to submit as of today and have decided to extend the contest until March the 17th 2017, also updating the prizes. The concerns about someone having a jump because of having the game longer do not seem to be an issue given the fact no one has completed and submitted with all items.

The first player who is able to collect the items and take the screenshots of the areas that are listed will be the winner of One NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti Graphics Card and also One HTC VIVE Unit! 

All the items below are required to be collected and the screenshot once collected. (SEE MORE DETAILS BELOW ON THE OFFICIAL RULES)
Chp1 (Note: Items will show in wrist device as collected)
All 5 Assets: 
Family history
Financial Records
HDD1
HDD2
HDD3

Chp1 extra
Labyrinth Key
Audio Files
(Note: Find the secret area that houses the virtual world. Then, locate the Labyrinth Key which will allow you access to the small ground vaults on the surface. Within one of the small ground vaults will be the audio files.  )

Chp2 (Note: Items will show in HUD as collected)
43/43 Codes
7/7 Journals

Chp3 (Note: Items will show in wrist device as collected)
4/4 Keys
10 Journals
1 Main key at the end

Once you have the above with your screenshots to verify, you additionally need to have taken screen shots of the areas we are referencing.

Chapter I Screenshot that is required with the above:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/8ffc8c2541ad5c508750ba31688dd240cb8f81c8.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/4a92aa8d1b7659d552ed2a871049dd6ab646a5d0.jpg[/img][/url]

Chapter II Screenshot that is required with the above:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/845e13a1e01764da7eea0963b23759b2c2db2793.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/6d11005f76a18d3422e815057105d78a5363f56f.jpg[/img][/url]

Chapter III Screenshot that is required with the above:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/be6bb79ac741ca1df18a7f49e2591feffac58add.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/0c4b587df57f2d5a95bbb669a75afadbb01f05b6.jpg[/img][/url]

Finish the game and get the screen shots of your HUD or your Wrist Device, having the items as well as taking the screen shots of the areas we are asking for and then be the first to submit. If you have all the items, shots requested, then send your screenshots of the collected items and the screenshots of the referenced screenshots above, and be the first one to submit these, along with leaving a review on Steam, be qualified, and you will be the winner. Send your submission when complete to Cypressinheritance@cypressinheritance.com [url=https://cypressinheritance.com/Official-Contest-Rules.pdf] Click here for official rules [/url]

We are running this promotion to build a larger user base and we also would appreciate reviews and feedback of the game with it being complete at this point.  We are still in the process of rebuild and are planning for the relaunch in late 2017!
We again thank you and hope you enjoy Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning.

notes.title: More improvements, more coming...
notes.content:
We have made additional fixes and added more game play features. Over the next few weeks we will be making even more improvements.

We have lowered the price of the game for the time being as we are working on these additional items. We are going to rebuild the entire game, adding much more content and strengthening the game play in UE4 to give the best experience possible. We plan to have this out sometime late next year at which time the price will be increased. Currently, it will stay at lower price and anyone who does purchase now will get the new UE4 version of the game at no additional charge. We could move to another game but we want to make sure that this, being the first PC game from Cypress Inheritance, is what it was intended be and is an enjoyable and entertaining experience. 

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Completed Chapter III and Updates
notes.content: In addition to the completed Chapter III, significant updates and improvements have been made to Chapter I since its initial release last year, as well as the addition of a tutorial level that covers all the important gameplay elements of Chapter I and II.  Although technically complete, the new team here at Cypress Inheritance is continuing to address technical and art related issues to improve the game. Major optimization has been achieved among the items being addressed and dramatically improved. Lastly, give us your feedback on  Chapter III. Even though it is a small part of the game, it is a huge step in the direction we wish to achieve in the art and game play.

notes.title: Chapter III Completed
notes.content: We have completed Chapter III and with this chapter this game is concluded.  With having new team members working on the game we have additionally made significant changes to other areas,  as well as dramatic optimization improvements. Specifically the caves in Chapter I  have been completely rebuilt and optimized to much higher level. We hope you enjoy and look forward to moving forward on the next installments.

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
We have just completed a substantial update for the AI. Additionally, more optimization changes have been made to increase performance. Lastly we have included a new tutorial section in the main menu that gives a very detailed outline of the game play.

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning
notes.content:
Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning is Now Available on Steam and is 30% off to celebrate!

Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning delivers a true-to-life, stealthy gaming experience set in multiple open worlds. As you experience our true cause and effect system while on the path to achieving your goals, the strategy you use will have consequences and those decisions will ultimately determine your success or failure. Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning will give you a unique gaming experience to enjoy.
